title: User Story
description: A structured representation of a user story for the ox-creature project.

title.description: A brief title summarizing the user story.

actor.description: The role or type of user who benefits from this story.

goal.description: What the actor wants to achieve.

reason.description: Why the actor wants to achieve this goal.

acceptance_criteria.description: Conditions that must be met for the story to be considered complete.

constraints.description: Limitations or restrictions that apply to the implementation.

proof_expected.description: Expected artifacts or evidence that will demonstrate completion.
